+# Chat with this Page — Chrome Extension + LangChain Backend
+
+## 1. Backend setup
+
+```bash
+cd backend
+python -m venv venv
+source venv/bin/activate   # Windows: venv\Scripts\activate
+pip install -r requirements.txt
+cp .env.example .env       # then paste your Groq API key into .env
+python app.py
+```
+
+The Flask dev server runs on `http://localhost:8000` with debug/auto-reload on.
+
+Get a free Groq API key at https://console.groq.com/keys
+
+## 2. Load the extension in Chrome
+
+1. Go to `chrome://extensions`
+2. Enable "Developer mode" (top right)
+3. Click "Load unpacked" → select the `extension` folder
+4. Pin the extension, open any webpage, click the icon
+
+## 3. Use it
+
+1. Click "Load this page" (this calls `WebBaseLoader` on the Flask backend, chunks the text, and embeds it into an in-memory FAISS index)
+2. Ask questions — each question retrieves the most relevant chunks and sends them to Groq's `llama-3.1-8b-instant` model
+
+## Notes / next steps
+
+- The vectorstore is in-memory and per-server-session — restarting the backend clears loaded pages.
+- CORS is wide open (`*`) for local dev; tighten this before sharing the extension with anyone else.
+- To deploy the backend (so you don't need `localhost` running), host it on Render/Railway and update `API_BASE` in `popup.js` plus `host_permissions` in `manifest.json`.

+import os
+from typing import Dict
+
+from dotenv import load_dotenv
+from flask import Flask, request, jsonify
+from flask_cors import CORS
+
+from langchain_community.document_loaders import WebBaseLoader
+from langchain_text_splitters import RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter
+from langchain_community.vectorstores import FAISS
+from langchain_community.embeddings import HuggingFaceEmbeddings
+from langchain_groq import ChatGroq
+
+load_dotenv()
+
+GROQ_API_KEY = os.getenv("GROQ_API_KEY")
+if not GROQ_API_KEY:
+    raise RuntimeError("Set GROQ_API_KEY in a .env file (see .env.example)")
+
+app = Flask(__name__)
+CORS(app)  # allow the chrome-extension:// origin to call this API
+
+embeddings = HuggingFaceEmbeddings(model_name="sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2")
+llm = ChatGroq(model="llama-3.1-8b-instant", temperature=0.2, api_key=GROQ_API_KEY)
+
+# In-memory cache: url -> FAISS vectorstore. Fine for a personal/local tool;
+# swap for a persistent store if you need it to survive server restarts.
+_STORE: Dict[str, FAISS] = {}
+
+
+@app.get("/health")
+def health():
+    return jsonify({"status": "ok"})
+
+
+@app.post("/load")
+def load_page():
+    data = request.get_json(silent=True) or {}
+    url = data.get("url")
+    if not url:
+        return jsonify({"detail": "Missing 'url' in request body"}), 400
+
+    try:
+        loader = WebBaseLoader(url)
+        docs = loader.load()
+    except Exception as e:
+        return jsonify({"detail": f"Could not load page: {e}"}), 400
+
+    if not docs or not docs[0].page_content.strip():
+        return jsonify({"detail": "No readable text found on that page"}), 400
+

+
